outcome: mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery rate)
duration of labor (first, second, total stages)
cohort: The study included 165 elderly parturients admitted to Tongde Hospital of Zhejiang Province, China between May 2018 and August 2019.
finding: Midwifery care significantly improved spontaneous vaginal delivery rates, shortened labor, reduced postpartum hemorrhage and neonatal asphyxia, and enhanced maternal psychological well-being and satisfaction compared to conventional nursing care.
mod_finding: Midwifery care significantly increased the spontaneous vaginal delivery rate.
